context.person: A person using a small-business banking application
context.user_goal: Check the final status before attempting another transfer.

product_state.preceding_state: A scheduled supplier transfer has left the account but has not reached the recipient.
product_state.current_state: The transfer was submitted at 2:05 PM. The amount is no longer available in the account balance.
known_facts: The transfer was submitted at 2:05 PM.
The amount is no longer available in the account balance.
The recipient has not confirmed receipt.
The bank will post a final status by the end of the next business day.

current_content.heading: Still working
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand bank transfer still pending, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View transfer details and the latest status.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Contact support after the stated review time.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The payment outcome is still pending and the funds are reserved.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Check the final status before attempting another transfer.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
